title: Google\Cloud\Dataproc\V1\GetWorkflowTemplateRequest
name: GetWorkflowTemplateRequest
description: A request to fetch a workflow template.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.name
params.description: Required. The resource name of the workflow template, as described in https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/resource_names. For projects.regions.workflowTemplates.get, the resource name of the template has the following format: projects/{project_id}/regions/{region}/workflowTemplates/{template_id} For projects.locations.workflowTemplates.get, the resource name of the template has the following format: projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/workflowTemplates/{template_id}

params.name: data.version
params.description: Optional. The version of workflow template to retrieve. Only previously instantiated versions can be retrieved. If unspecified, retrieves the current version.
